title: Sheet lead.
officialText:
Sheet lead for pans shall not weigh less than 4 pounds per square foot (19.5 kg/m2) coated with an asphalt paint or
other approved coating.
SECTION PC 403
MINIMUM PLUMBING FACILITIES
